title: Block Bloom
tagline: Fill a line, grow a garden!
description: A calm, clever block puzzle: drag pieces onto the 8×8 garden, fill rows and columns to make them bloom, chain combos and earn power-ups. Every deal is fair, there is a hold slot and an undo, and Today's Puzzle gives the whole family the same pieces.
how_to: Drag a piece onto the garden. Fill a whole row or column and it blooms away.
Clear lines on back-to-back turns for a combo. Empty the whole garden for a big bonus.
Drop a piece on Hold to save it. Combos earn power-ups: rotate, bloom bomb and new pieces.
Every deal can always be placed. You have one undo a game. Try Today's Puzzle with the family!
